ideas.pitch: A localized mesh networking toolkit using ESP32 and BLE for offline hackathon venues to communicate without stable venue Wi-Fi.
ideas.title: ClanWar Mesh Bridge
ideas.why_it_could_win: Leverages the winning pattern of hard engineering and offline disaster communication used in HACKATHON-prahari-link-TEAM-SB, which impresses judges who deal with spotty venue internet.

ideas.pitch: Predictive analytics dashboard forecasting team code output velocities and bug incidents using Poisson regression models.
ideas.title: CommitCombat AI Forecaster
ideas.why_it_could_win: Adapts the rigorous statistical forecasting methodology of the Apart Research AI Forecasting hackathon winner into a gamified dev metric.

ideas.pitch: An automated risk-detection platform analyzing collaborative repo contributions and spotting malicious or suspicious commit patterns using graph intelligence.
ideas.title: GitClan Graph AML Radar
ideas.why_it_could_win: Replicates the graph intelligence and LightGBM pattern of the DIGITIMES AI Innovation winner, targeting software integrity and security.

ideas.pitch: Computer vision posture and ergonomics tracker built for developers grinding through 32-hour hackathons, using MediaPipe pose detection.
ideas.title: ArenaPose Form Checker
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly applies the computer vision and biomechanics classification approach of the NeuroForge Hackathon winner to hackathon participant wellness.

ideas.pitch: A multi-agent LangGraph platform providing real-time architectural guidance and debugging help specifically tailored for competing hackathon clans.
ideas.title: ClanOps AI Multi-Agent Mentor
ideas.why_it_could_win: Follows the exact multi-agent RAG pattern of the GreenNovation Hackathon winner to deliver immediate, practical value to fellow competitors.
